spec.situation_desc: has a card payment they don't recognise

utterances.speaker: agent
utterances.text: Good morning, Thistle Bank, Zara speaking. How can I help?

utterances.speaker: customer
utterances.text: Hi, I’m Carys Sutherland. There’s a card payment I don’t recognise, and I’m really unhappy that I’ve had to chase you about it.

utterances.speaker: agent
utterances.text: I’m sorry you’ve had to chase us, Carys. I’ll look into this with you. Before we discuss your account, could you confirm your full name and date of birth, please?

utterances.speaker: agent
utterances.text: Thank you. And the first line of your address, please?

utterances.speaker: agent
utterances.text: Thanks, that’s verified. I can see a card payment for £186.40 to Northstar Digital on 21 October. Is that the one you don’t recognise?

utterances.speaker: customer
utterances.text: Yes. I’ve never bought anything from them. I called two days ago and was told someone would get back to me, but nobody did.

utterances.speaker: agent
utterances.text: I’m sorry we didn’t get back to you when we said we would. I’ll take ownership of this. I’m logging this as a complaint about the payment and the lack of follow-up.

utterances.speaker: customer
utterances.text: Good, because I want this sorted out.

utterances.speaker: agent
utterances.text: I understand. I can’t promise what the investigation will find, but I’ll make sure the payment is reviewed and that your complaint is handled. I’ll submit the complaint and payment query today, and I’ll call you by 5 pm tomorrow with an update.

utterances.speaker: customer
utterances.text: All right. What happens after that?

utterances.speaker: agent
utterances.text: We’ll investigate the payment and review what happened when you contacted us. We’ll send you a full written response to your complaint within 15 business days. I’ll call you by 5 pm tomorrow with the update, even if the investigation is still ongoing.

utterances.speaker: agent
utterances.text: Just to recap: I’ve logged this as a complaint, I’ll submit the payment query today, and I’ll call you by 5 pm tomorrow. You’ll receive a full written response within 15 business days. Does that all make sense?

utterances.speaker: agent
utterances.text: Thank you, Carys. I’m sorry again for the trouble, and I’ll follow this up as agreed.
